BinyuanUltimateSamplerEN.display_name: 🛡️ Binyuan Sampler V2.2 EN｜中英双语版
BinyuanUltimateSamplerEN.description: All-in-one bilingual sampler: loads a whole checkpoint or a split stack (diffusion model + dual CLIP + VAE), encodes prompts, samples and decodes - and also outputs model/CLIP/VAE/latent/conditioning for chaining. Supports Flux / SD3 / Wan / Qwen-Image / Qwen-Image-2.1 / Krea2 / Z-Image / LTXV / Hunyuan / Lumina2 ... English + Chinese UI.

load_mode.name: Load Mode
load_mode.tooltip: Whole-file Checkpoint, or Separate stack (diffusion model + CLIP + VAE).

checkpoint.name: Checkpoint
checkpoint.tooltip: Whole-file .safetensors checkpoint (used when Load Mode = Checkpoint).

diffusion_model.name: Diffusion Model
diffusion_model.tooltip: Diffusion/UNet weights (.safetensors or .gguf; .gguf needs ComfyUI-GGUF installed).

clip_1.name: CLIP 1
clip_1.tooltip: Text encoder 1 (the only one for single-encoder models).

clip_2.name: CLIP 2
clip_2.tooltip: Second text encoder for dual-CLIP models (e.g. Flux: clip_l + t5).

clip_type.name: CLIP Type
clip_type.tooltip: For Qwen-Image-2.1 select qwen_image_2.1 (alias of qwen_image). Use the matching Qwen3-VL 8B image encoder.

vae.name: VAE
vae.tooltip: Split models require their matching VAE. Qwen-Image-2.1 needs its 64-channel RGBA VAE, not the older Wan VAE.

weight_precision.name: Weight Precision
weight_precision.tooltip: default / fp8 / nvfp4 / bf16 ... must be supported by your runtime.

chaining_mode.name: Chaining Mode
chaining_mode.tooltip: Inherit upstream = use the MODEL/CLIP/VAE wired into the optional inputs.

upstream_image_handling.name: Upstream Image Handling
upstream_image_handling.tooltip: How upstream images are prepared before sampling.

latent_source.name: Latent Source
latent_source.tooltip: Qwen-Image-2.1 uses upstream images as references and starts from an empty latent matching the first reference. External latent priority and stitching remain available.

negative_prompt.name: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.tooltip: Leave empty for models that do not use CFG.

size_preset.name: Size Preset
size_preset.tooltip: Pick a preset to fill Width/Height automatically, or Custom.

flux_guidance.name: Flux Guidance
flux_guidance.tooltip: Embedded guidance for Flux / flux2 / pixeldit style CLIPs.

denoise.name: Denoise
denoise.tooltip: For Qwen-Image-2.1 reference editing, use 1.0. Reduce it when intentionally resampling an external latent.

lora_json.name: LoRA JSON
lora_json.tooltip: LoRA list in JSON (written by the LoRA manager UI above; can also be typed by hand).

lora_list.name: LoRA List
lora_list.tooltip: Pick one LoRA (used by the LoRA manager UI).

cleanup_vram.name: Clear VRAM After Run
cleanup_vram.tooltip: Free VRAM and run GC after generating.

lora_settings.name: LoRA Settings
lora_settings.tooltip: Optional BINYUAN_LORA_SETTINGS input from the Binyuan LoRA Settings node.

upstream_image_1.name: Upstream Image 1
upstream_image_1.tooltip: Qwen-Image-2.1 reference image: sent to both the vision encoder and VAE; RGBA is preserved. One image per input.

upstream_image_2.name: Upstream Image 2
upstream_image_2.tooltip: Qwen-Image-2.1 reference image: sent to both the vision encoder and VAE; RGBA is preserved. One image per input.

upstream_image_3.name: Upstream Image 3
upstream_image_3.tooltip: Qwen-Image-2.1 reference image: sent to both the vision encoder and VAE; RGBA is preserved. One image per input.

qwen_reference_resolution.name: Qwen reference resolution
qwen_reference_resolution.tooltip: Qwen-Image-2.1 only: reference pixel budget is resolution squared; 0 preserves original size, aligned to 32. Output follows the first reference.

qwen_edit_mode.name: Qwen Edit Mode
qwen_edit_mode.tooltip: Auto preserves existing workflows. Native reference edit uses official reference conditioning and an empty latent. VAE redraw uses the reference latent as the starting canvas and enables Denoise.

attention_backend.name: Attention Backend
attention_backend.tooltip: Auto safe selects Comfy Kitchen for internally loaded Krea2/Qwen-Image-2.1 models when available, otherwise sub-quadratic attention. Externally patched models and other families keep their own backend. Core default follows ComfyUI startup flags.
